name: LocalRecall
description: A lightweight, no-frills RESTful API designed for managing knowledge bases and files stored in vector databases—no GPU, internet, or cloud services required!

paths.name: Database Path
paths.description: Path to the database directory for LocalRecall

paths.name: Assets Path
paths.description: Path to the assets directory for LocalRecall

variables.name: OpenAI API - Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API. If using LocalAI on the same machine, set to http://IP_ADDRESS:8080

variables.name: OpenAI API - Key
variables.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible API.

variables.name: Internal Collections Database Path
variables.description: Internal path to the collections database. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Assets Path
variables.description: Internal path to the assets directory. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Vector Engine
variables.description: Vector database engine to use. Currently only 'postgres' is supported.

variables.name: Hybrid Search - BM25 Weight
variables.description: Weight for BM25 in hybrid search (0.0 to 1.0).

variables.name: Hybrid Search - Vector Weight
variables.description: Weight for vector search in hybrid search (0.0 to 1.0).
